mapper.select: SELECT MSG_ID AS msgId, LANG_CD AS langCd, MSG_TYPE AS msgType, MSG_CONTENT AS msgContent, DESCRIPTION AS description, IS_USE AS isUse FROM com_message WHERE IS_USE = 'Y'

SELECT MSG_ID AS msgId, LANG_CD AS langCd, MSG_TYPE AS msgType, MSG_CONTENT AS msgContent, DESCRIPTION AS description, IS_USE AS isUse, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM com_message WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_message WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_message (MSG_ID, LANG_CD, MSG_TYPE, MSG_CONTENT, DESCRIPTION, IS_USE) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{langCd}, #{msgType}, #{msgContent}, #{description}, IFNULL(#{isUse}, 'Y'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM com_message WHERE MSG_ID = #{msgId} AND LANG_CD = #{langCd}
